content: McSwEmulationMethodSupport . category The value of McSwEmulationMethodSupport . category can either correspond to the enumera- tion value of the RTE configuration parameter RteCalibrationSupport (namely DOUBLE_POINTERED , SINGLE_POINTERED or INITIALIZED_RAM , see [13]), or it can be chosen differently in order to denote a vendor specific method.
